text:
Alex: quick proposal — tweak Cluster Autoscaler for GPU pools to cut churn during short bursts. want to run a small canary. :thinking:
Priya: sounds good. what flags are you thinking? any perf numbers?
Alex: initial idea: bump --scale-down-unneeded-time, limit bulk deletes, and change expander behavior to avoid splitting fractional GPUs across nodes. short list: 
```
--scale-down-unneeded-time=15m
--scale-down-delay-after-add=10m
--max-empty-bulk-delete=1
--expander=least-waste
--scale-down-utilization-threshold=0.5
```
Jon: least-waste makes sense for GPU since binpacking matters, but it can leave more idle CPU. we need to watch pending pods increase. query we can use: `sum(kube_pod_status_phase{phase="Pending"} and on(node) group_left() kube_node_labels{label_k8s_io_role="gpu"})` (will refine).
Megan: we ran a similar tweak last quarter but with --scale-down-unneeded-time=20m and saw ~12% GPU spend drop on a test fleet. downside was a few extra idle minutes per burst. recommend canary in eu-west1 first. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Alex: canary pool name? prefer isolated nodepool to avoid noisy neighbor rollout.
Megan: create `gpu-canary-low-churn` with smaller max size and same taints. we can route lower-priority batch jobs there initially.
Priya: two gotchas: 1) network attach/detach delays (eni/cni) can keep pods Terminating and block scale-down. 2) daemonsets with hostNetwork often block drain. need to add tolerations or cordon strategy.
Jon: agree on CNI — add `--max-graceful-termination=2m` in drain strategy? or handle via `evictionPolicy` adjustments on heavy pods. also watch the `kubelet` evict/log spikes.
Alex: plan: create canary pool, apply flags on a CA replica watching only that pool (so global CA unaffected), run 48h, collect: 95th latency, pending counts, GPU-util, and tokenized cost.
Megan: for rollout steps: 1) create nodepool 2) label pool and add to ca config 3) deploy CA instance with new flags and `--node-group-auto-discovery` targeting the label 4) route small subset of jobs 5) monitor dashboards + burn credits
Priya: add alert on pending>5 for >5m and scale-down-failure-counts in logs. also keep `--unremovable-node-ttl` conservative.
infra-bot: deploy-started: cluster-autoscaler/gpu-canary@sha256:abc123 -> applying flags to ca-canary-eu-west1 (rollout id: r-2026-03-18-01) :zap:
Jon: will run a quick sim in the capacity planner to estimate nodehours difference. will post numbers in ~2h.
Alex: sweet. if anyone sees pods stuck draining during canary ping me and we'll abort. I'll create the canary PR now. :thumbsup:
